Register your interest and share a few details about your dog. Our team will contact you about further screening. Register your interest → See how it works → Why we are running this trial From Rosie’s story to a future for more dogs. Rosie The first dog treated with a personalised neoantigen vaccine. It began with Rosie. Her experience with a personalised neoantigen vaccine encouraged Paul to explore how this approach could one day be made available to every dog with cancer. Before an approach like this can become broadly available, we must study it carefully and support it by evidence for review by the relevant veterinary regulators.
